{{Spoiler}}

A '''gilded empanada''' is the secret meal of the [[Golden Apple|golden apple]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Absorption}} II for 4 minutes and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} II for 45 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_apple_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Golden Apple|baked golden apple]], sugar, estus ash and dough. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a gilded empanada takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Absorption II (4 extra hearts) for 4:00 and Regeneration II for 0:45. Unlike other foods, its healing Regeneration III isn't hidden, so its icon and particles show for its 5 seconds. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
